properties.label: Typography as optical field
properties.text: Fill an ivory optical specimen with oversized two-line black typography and overlap it with one thick oblate glass lens. Keep the enormous type and lens as the entire visual event; place two quiet captions and one compact lens-position control at the bottom.

properties.label: Oversized two-line optical type
properties.text: Use enormous near-black two-line typography as the sampled visual field, with thin horizontal registration lines and a small acid-yellow mark as optical reference points.

properties.label: Thick oblate meniscus lens
properties.text: Use a single thick oblate lens with a rounded meniscus-like edge, scaled roughly 1.08/.97/.44 in the showcase implementation.

properties.label: Ivory, near-black and acid yellow
properties.text: Use ivory #f5f5f0, near-black #20231f, a small acid-yellow registration mark and transparent glass with slight cyan absorption.

properties.label: Physical refracting glass
properties.text: Make the lens magnify and bend the letterforms behind it, with sharp elongated softbox reflections, a faint cyan rim, clear dark/light internal boundaries and a soft offset contact shadow. The showcase uses a Three.js physical glass sphere with transmission 1, roughness .015, thickness 1.25, IOR 1.48, dispersion .028 and clearcoat 1, viewed orthographically over a CanvasTexture typography plane. These are showcase implementation values, not claims about the source author.

properties.label: Dragged optical refraction
properties.text: Horizontal drag or a slider moves the lens across the words, while pointer height influences vertical position. Real refraction moves with it.

properties.label: Demand-rendered optical states
properties.text: Render on demand with no idle animation loop after settling. Keep three composed fallback positions and a separate portrait crop.

properties.label: Semantic optical source text
properties.text: The text behind the lens is a CanvasTexture scene plane; preserve equivalent semantic DOM text and restore it normally if the renderer cannot present the optical layer.

properties.label: Matched-position viewport check
properties.text: Compare the same lens position against the live scene at 1440x900, 1280x720 and 390x844. Inspect letter distortion, rim width, highlight shape, shadow offset and lens scale.

properties.label: True refraction quality bar
properties.text: A frosted rectangle, backdrop blur or glossy CSS bubble is below this target. Reuse the actual optical implementation if needed to preserve the effect.
